name: OpenFamily
description: Privacy-first self-hosted family organizer: shopping lists, tasks, shared calendar, recipes, meal planning, and budget. Registration is open by default: anyone who can reach the instance can create an account and their own family, so create your account right after deploy, then set Registration to 'false'. Note: 'false' freezes ALL account creation (invite-link signups included), so flip it back to 'true' whenever you onboard a new member.

value.title: Allow self-registration
value.description: When 'true', anyone who can reach this instance can create an account (their own family). When 'false', the server refuses every new registration, invite links included (accounts that already exist can still join a family via invite), and the login page still shows a signup form that will be refused. Use 'true' to create the first owner account and while onboarding invited members, 'false' the rest of the time.

value.title: JWT signing secret
value.description: Generated by the platform at instance creation. Signs auth tokens; the server requires at least 32 characters.
